title: F-shaped scanning and text formatting with headings and bullets
statement:
Users scan web pages in an 'F-shaped' pattern when text lacks formatting, causing them to miss critical content; designers must use headings, bolding, and bullets to force a 'layer-cake' scanning pattern.

Options:
- Scannable Headings: Layer-cake layout (heavy use of descriptive H2s/H3s) (fits: blogs, long form articles, documentation)
- Keyword Emphasis: Spotted scanning layout (bolded keywords and distinct links) (fits: product descriptions, specifications)
- Data Chunking: Bulleted list grouping (fits: pricing features, how to guides)
- F-Pattern Trigger (Avoid): Unformatted wall of text (fits: legal disclaimers, terms of service)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, landing pages, content sites. Audience: general, b2b buyers, adults.

source.title: F-Shaped Pattern of Reading on the Web: Misunderstood, But Still Relevant (Even on Mobile)
